id.name: Matroid.IsUnionDisjointCircuits.dep_or_empty
id.content:
/-- Union of disjoint circuits is either dependent or empty. -/
lemma Matroid.IsUnionDisjointCircuits.dep_or_empty {M : Matroid α} {X : Set α} (hMX : M.IsUnionDisjointCircuits X) :
    M.Dep X ∨ X = ∅ :=
  have ⟨F, hXF⟩ := hMX
  hXF ▸ F.dep_or_empty

C1_dependencies.content:
/-- A set is a collection of elements of some type `α`.

Although `Set` is defined as `α → Prop`, this is an implementation detail which should not be
relied on. Instead, `setOf` and membership of a set (`∈`) should be used to convert between sets
and predicates.
-/
def Set (α : Type u) := α → Prop
